name: gemini-web-search
description: Search provider for the harness web capability seam (ctx.web): registers the id `gemini`, whose answers come from the Google GEMINI API's native `google_search` grounding tool (server-side web search with real source URLs in groundingMetadata). No third-party search API, no browser, no paid search key: the only request it issues is models/<id>:generateContent with x-goog-api-key resolved BY NAME through ctx.credentials.

config.description: The provider row: which credential NAME to resolve, which Gemini model to call, and which provider id to register with ctx.web.

apiKeyEnv.description: Credential NAME of the Gemini API key (default GEMINI_API_KEY). A NAME only: the value is resolved at CALL time through ctx.credentials, never read from config, never logged.

model.description: Gemini model id used for the grounded search (default gemini-2.5-flash, a real API-accepted id).

apiBase.description: API root (default https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta); a proxy or a stub server may override it.

providerId.description: Provider id registered with the seam (default gemini), the value web.searchProvider names in a role patch.

grounded.description: Send the native google_search grounding tool (default true). false keeps the same route but answers without web grounding.

timeoutMs.description: Per-call deadline of one Gemini request in ms (default 30000, max 120000).
